articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring natively fused vision-language-audio reasoning and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. Early benchmarks show step-change improvements in complex multi-step math, code generation, and agentic task completion, though researchers note diminishing returns on certain narrow NLP tasks compared to the GPT-4o to GPT-5 leap.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro has taken the lead on SWE-Bench Verified and HumanEval-Agent, demonstrating an ability to autonomously resolve real-world GitHub issues with over 65% success rate. The model integrates a refined chain-of-thought architecture with built-in tool use, intensifying the competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the agentic coding space.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure Robotics announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robot has entered commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, performing bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The deployment marks one of the first scaled commercial uses of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Achieves Real-Time Autonomous Warehouse Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas robot autonomously navigating a cluttered warehouse environment, picking and placing irregular packages using a new vision-language-action model for manipulation planning. The milestone shows Atlas transitioning from scripted demos to genuinely adaptive behavior in unstructured commercial settings.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Agents' — Persistent AI Workers for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Agents, a platform allowing enterprises to deploy persistent, sandboxed AI agents that can execute multi-hour workflows involving web research, code execution, and document drafting with human-in-the-loop checkpoints. The system uses Constitutional AI-based guardrails to bound agent behavior, addressing key enterprise concerns around reliability and auditability.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced early volume production on its N14P (1.4nm-class) process node, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node leverages gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, promising a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction versus its 2nm predecessor, with AI accelerator chips expected to be first adopters.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded BCI Trials Targeting Spinal Cord Injury
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its brain-computer interface clinical trials to patients with spinal cord injuries, building on positive results from its initial ALS and paralysis cohort. Early participants demonstrated reliable cursor control and text input at speeds approaching 40 words per minute, marking a significant milestone for implantable BCI technology.

articles.title: Toyota Research Institute Unveils Diffusion-Policy-Based Robot That Learns Kitchen Tasks from 10 Demonstrations
articles.summary: Toyota Research Institute published results on a new diffusion-policy learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to learn complex kitchen manipulation tasks — such as cracking eggs and assembling sandwiches — from as few as 10 human teleoperation demonstrations. The approach dramatically reduces data requirements compared to prior imitation learning methods, suggesting a path toward practical household robotics.
